items.rationale: Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like renewal of the frost-fractured valve. Case 16 supports €52 gross for one valve.
Section 7.1.9 covers the hose if it had to be renewed with the fractured valve. Case 16 supports €30 gross for one hose.
Sections 7.1.7(f) and 7.1.9 cover labour needed to repair the fitting. Three hours at €95 gross gives €285, consistent with Case 16.

Section 7.1.7(e) covers consumables actually used in the repair, but §3.6(c) excludes the contractor’s own tools and small equipment. Allow €9 gross if this is a separately incurred consumables charge, consistent with Case 16.
Sections 7.1.9 and 7.1.11 cover one attendance for the insured repair. Allow €65 gross, consistent with Case 16.
Sections 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 expressly cover imaging used to locate the confirmed escape. Allow €49 gross for one use; the €2,500 gross leak-location cap is not reached.
Sections 2.6.4 and 3.5 exclude frost acting from outside because the optional peril is not shown as agreed. No escaped water reached the facade, so §2.4.3 does not apply.
Section 3.5(b) expressly excludes removal of failed render caused by uninsured external frost. No amount is payable.
Sections 3.5(b) and 7.1.7 exclude substrate work on an area damaged only by uninsured external frost. No amount is payable.
Sections 3.5(d) and 7.1.10 exclude the upgrade. Because the underlying facade damage is also excluded, there is no allowance for equivalent plain render.
Section 3.5(b) excludes re-forming the substrate after uninsured external frost damage. No amount is payable.
Section 3.5(b) excludes all finish coats associated with uninsured external frost damage, regardless of the number applied. No amount is payable.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.6 exclude repainting separate undamaged elevations for appearance matching. No amount is payable.
Section 3.5(b) expressly excludes priming associated with uninsured external frost damage. No amount is payable.
Sections 3.5(c) and 7.1.11 exclude labour associated with the uninsured facade work. None of the five hours is payable.
Under §§7.1.12–7.1.13, a lump sum follows the work it prices, and no insured work is identified on the painting account. If this is an administrative fee instead, §3.6(b) excludes it.
